transcript.content: Hello, I’m glad you came in today. What brings you in today?

For the past three weeks, I've been feeling completely emotionally numb and my head feels incredibly foggy. I also feel really detached from myself, almost like I'm watching my own life as an outsider. I'm just struggling to think clearly and wanted to get some help.
Did these feelings start after a very frightening or traumatic event, such as an accident, assault, or something that made you feel your life or safety was in danger? If so, when did it happen?
Yes, they started exactly three weeks ago right after a very scary and shocking incident where I felt my safety was threatened. Ever since that day, I haven't been able to shake these feelings.
Since the traumatic event happened three weeks ago, have these symptoms been present only during this first month after it happened, or have they lasted longer than one month?
They have only been going on for these past three weeks since the event occurred. It hasn't been longer than a month yet, as everything started right after that day.
Since the event, have you had unwanted memories or nightmares about it, or have you been avoiding reminders of what happened?
No, I haven't really had any nightmares or unwanted memories about what happened. I also haven't been trying to avoid reminders of the event either.
Since the event, have you felt unreal, like the world around you isn’t real, or like you’re detached from your body or emotions?

Yes, I've been feeling exactly like that. I feel completely detached from my own body, like I'm watching myself from the outside, and the world around me feels foggy and dreamlike. My mind also feels totally empty and emotionally numb, as if all my feelings have just been blocked out.
Since the event, have you also been feeling very on edge, easily startled, having trouble sleeping, or finding it hard to concentrate?

I'm having a really difficult time concentrating, to the point where I can't even focus on conversations, reading, or watching TV. However, I haven't really noticed feeling on edge, being easily startled, or having trouble sleeping. Those haven't been my main issues at all.
Since the event, have you felt unable to experience positive emotions, such as feeling happy, close to others, or loving toward people you care about?

Yes, I feel completely numb and unable to experience any happiness, even when good things happen. I also feel a distressing lack of love or affection toward my family and loved ones, as if all my positive emotions have been totally blocked.
Are these symptoms causing major problems in your daily life, such as at work, school, or in your relationships?

I'm not entirely sure, to be honest. I've been feeling so emotionally numb and distracted lately that I haven't really been able to keep track of how it's affecting my daily routine or my relationships. Everything just feels like a blur right now.
Have these symptoms made it hard for you to do your usual work or school tasks, or caused noticeable strain with family or friends?

Yes, it's been incredibly hard to get any work done because my concentration is so poor and I struggle to make simple decisions. It's also causing a lot of strain with my family because I feel so numb and unable to show them any affection right now.
